# Extract the data for the years of interest (e.g., 2015) and include 'Country Group' and 'Country Code'
year = '2015 [YR2015]'

# Extract the relevant data for education expenditure and GNI per capita
education_expenditure_data = df_education[['Country Group', 'Country Code', year]].rename(columns={year: 'education_expenditure'})
gdp_data = df_gdp_corrected[['Country Group', 'Country Code', year]].rename(columns={year: 'gdp'})

# Merge the datasets on 'Country Group' and 'Country Code'
merged_data = pd.merge(education_expenditure_data, gdp_data, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code'])

# Display the merged data
merged_data
